Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom, within thumb reach, on accounts that show it at the top. Restart Facebook to see the change.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Keep the top bar on screen; a big screen is a tablet or the inner screen of a folding phone, and the phone layout is the one Facebook shows on a normal phone
Phone layout on big screens
# context: description of that switch; on a big screen Facebook keeps the tab bar at the top in a wider layout, so the tab bar switches above it do nothing there

A tablet or an unfolded phone gets the layout Facebook uses on a phone, so the tab bar choices above work on the big screen too. Facebook's wider big screen layout goes away. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a big screen yet. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Tablet ya da açılmış katlanabilir telefon, Facebook'un telefonda kullandığı düzeni alır. Böylece yukarıdaki sekme çubuğu ayarları büyük ekranda da çalışır. Facebook'un büyük ekranlar için daha geniş düzeni kalkar. Varsayılan olarak kapalı, çünkü büyük bir ekranda henüz denenmedi. Değişikliği görmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, after Phone layout on big screens; it makes Facebook's top bar (search and Messenger) and its tab bar partly transparent
See-through bars
# context: description of that switch; the feed is the list of posts on Home, and blurred means frosted like glass
The top bar and the tab bar turn see-through, so the feed shows through them as you scroll. On Android 12 and newer the feed behind them is blurred.
column2: Üst çubuk ve sekme çubuğu saydam olur, böylece kaydırırken akış arkalarından görünür. Android 12 ve sonrasında arkalarındaki akış bulanıklaştırılır.

Force dark mode
# context: description of that switch; on some tablets Facebook's own Settings page has no Dark mode row
Keeps Facebook dark no matter its own setting. Meant for tablets where Facebook has no Dark mode switch. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Facebook'un kendi ayarı ne olursa olsun karanlık kalmasını sağlar. Facebook'ta Karanlık mod anahtarı olmayan tabletler için. Değişikliği görmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın.

column1: # context: switch title under Appearance, shown with the AMOLED black theme; it makes cards, comments and menus pure black like the page
Black cards
# context: description of that switch; a card is a raised panel such as a post or the Menu's profile box, near black is the dark gray the theme gives it

Cards and menus take the page's own color instead of the near black that sets them apart. Buttons and search fields keep a dark gray fill, so you can still see them. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Kartlar ve menüler, onları ayıran neredeyse siyah renk yerine sayfanın kendi rengini alır. Düğmeler ve arama alanları koyu gri dolgusunu korur, böylece onları görmeye devam edersiniz. Değişikliği görmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın.

column1: Settings imported.
Video file name

%1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Facebook, %3$s who posted it, %4$s their profile's number on Facebook and %5$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %6$s.

# context: summary of that switch; Save videos other apps can open is the switch above it, VP9, AV1 and H.264 are video formats and stay as they are

With Save videos other apps can open on, a full size video Facebook only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Slower, and videos over 10 minutes stay smaller.
column2: Videoları diğer uygulamaların açabileceği biçimde kaydet açıkken, Facebook'ta yalnızca VP9 veya AV1 olarak bulunan tam boyutlu bir video, daha küçük kaydedilmek yerine telefonunda H.264'e dönüştürülür. Daha yavaştır ve 10 dakikadan uzun videolar küçük kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads; on, a save shows no message when it starts, finishes or is canceled
Quiet saves
# context: summary of that switch; a toast is Android's short message at the bottom of the screen
No toast when a save starts, finishes or is canceled. A save that fails still says why.
column2: Kaydetme başladığında, bittiğinde veya iptal edildiğinde mesaj gösterilmez. Kaydetme başarısız olursa nedeni yine gösterilir.

column1: # context: section title for the Chats settings, named like Facebook's own Chats screen
Chats
# context: switch title under Chats; the card is Facebook's own "Get the Messenger app" card
Hide the Get Messenger card
# context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name and stays as it is
Hides the card at the top of Chats that asks you to get Messenger, once Messenger is installed. Without Messenger, the card stays.
column2: Messenger kuruluysa Sohbetler'in üstündeki, Messenger'ı edinmenizi isteyen kartı gizler. Messenger yoksa kart kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; the notes and active now row is the row of friends' notes and who's active above the chat list in Chats inside Facebook
Hide the notes and active now row
# context: summary of that switch
Removes the row above your chats that shows friends' notes and who's active. Your own note tile may go too. Your chats stay.
column2: Sohbetlerin üstündeki, arkadaşlarınızın notlarını ve kimlerin aktif olduğunu gösteren satırı kaldırır. Kendi not kutunuz da kaybolabilir. Sohbetleriniz kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; promotions are the banners Facebook puts at the top of the chat list
Hide chat list promotions
# context: summary of that switch
Hides the banners at the top of Chats, like the one asking you to turn on notifications.
column2: Sohbetler'in üstündeki, bildirimleri açmanızı isteyen gibi bannerları gizler.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the button sits beside the search box at the top of Chats and on Chats' search screen
Hide the Meta AI button in Chats
# context: summary of that switch; your chats with Meta AI are conversations with the assistant, which stay in the list
Removes the Meta AI button beside the search box in Chats, at the top of the list and on the search screen. The search box stays, and so do your chats with Meta AI.
column2: Sohbetler'de arama kutusunun yanındaki Meta AI düğmesini, listenin üstünde ve arama ekranında kaldırır. Arama kutusu ve Meta AI ile sohbetleriniz kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook's Messenger icon opens the Messenger app
Open the Messenger app
# context: summary of that switch; Messenger is the app's name, Chats is Facebook's own chat screen as named above
Tapping the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook opens the Messenger app instead of Chats. Without Messenger, Chats opens as before.
column2: Facebook'un üstündeki Messenger simgesine dokunmak Sohbetler yerine Messenger uygulamasını açar. Messenger yoksa Sohbetler eskisi gibi açılır.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; on, Facebook leaves ringing for calls and notifying about chats to the Messenger app
Leave calls and chats to Messenger
# context: summary of that switch; signed out means not logged in to the Messenger app, turned off means the app is disabled in Android's settings

Facebook leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while Messenger is installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing this switch, or after installing, removing, enabling or disabling Messenger, so call routing updates. If you're signed out of Messenger, you'll miss calls and messages.
column2: Messenger yüklü ve etkin olduğu sürece Facebook aramaları ve sohbet bildirimlerini Messenger'a bırakır. Bu anahtarı değiştirdikten veya Messenger'ı yükledikten, kaldırdıktan, etkinleştirdikten ya da devre dışı bıraktıktan sonra arama yönlendirmesinin güncellenmesi için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın. Messenger'da oturumunuz kapalıysa aramaları ve mesajları kaçırırsınız.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Tap to play switch
Playback
# context: switch title; on, videos and music wait for a tap before they play
Tap to play
# context: summary of that switch; Autoplay and Off are the name and value of Facebook's own setting, as Facebook shows them in this language
Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of playing by themselves. Facebook's own Autoplay setting shows Off while this is on.
column2: Videolar, reeller, hikayeler ve müzik kendiliğinden oynamak yerine dokunuşunuzu bekler. Bu açıkken Facebook'un kendi Otomatik oynat ayarı Kapalı görünür.

column1: # context: switch title under Opening Facebook; Marketplace is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Marketplace only
# context: switch title under Opening Facebook, next to Marketplace only; Events is Facebook's tab and keeps its name
Events only
# context: summary of that switch; the tab names are Facebook's own, as its tab bar shows them
# context: switch title under Menu; Upgrades is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Upgrades
# context: summary of that switch; Settings and Help and support are Facebook's own Menu sections
The Upgrades section and its offers leave Facebook's Menu. Settings, Help and support and the rest of the Menu stay.
column2: “Yükseltmeler” bölümü ve teklifleri Facebook menüsünden kalkar. Ayarlar, Yardım ve destek ve menünün geri kalanı yerinde kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Also from Meta is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Also from Meta
Hide the Muse card
The Muse card, Meta's ad for its AI agent app, leaves the top of Facebook's Menu.
column2: Muse kartı, Meta'nın yapay zekâ asistanı uygulamasının reklamı, Facebook menüsünün üstünden kalkar.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the section links to Meta's other apps and shows ads for its devices
The Also from Meta section leaves Facebook's Menu, with its links to Meta's other apps and its ads for Meta's devices. Your own shortcuts stay.
column2: “Meta'dan diğerleri” bölümü, Meta'nın diğer uygulamalarına giden bağlantıları ve Meta cihazlarının reklamlarıyla birlikte Facebook menüsünden kalkar. Kendi kısayolların yerinde kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Help and support is the name of a section in Facebook's own Menu
Hide Help and support
# context: summary of that switch; Settings and privacy is Facebook's own Menu section
The Help and support section leaves Facebook's Menu, header and all. Settings and privacy stays.
column2: “Yardım ve destek” bölümü başlığıyla birlikte Facebook menüsünden kalkar. “Ayarlar ve gizlilik” yerinde kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Menu; Settings and privacy is a section of Facebook's own Menu that folds and unfolds when its header is tapped
Keep Settings and privacy expanded
# context: summary of that switch
Settings and privacy in Facebook's Menu stays open, so its rows show without a tap.
column2: “Ayarlar ve gizlilik” Facebook menüsünde açık kalır, böylece satırları dokunmadan görünür.

column1: # context: section title for the search settings, named like Facebook's own search
Search
# context: switch title under Search; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name
Hide Meta AI in search
# context: summary of that switch; Meta AI and Ask Meta AI are Meta's own names, as Facebook shows them
Search no longer shows Meta AI answers or Ask Meta AI prompts, or sends your search to Meta AI. Results for people, groups, pages and posts stay.
column2: Arama artık Meta AI yanıtlarını veya Ask Meta AI önerilerini göstermez, aramanızı Meta AI'a da göndermez. Kişi, grup, sayfa ve gönderi sonuçları kalır.

column1: # context: settings section heading for the Default comment order switch and its list
# context: switch title; on, a post's comments open in the order chosen in the list below it
Default comment order
# context: summary of that switch; a link to a comment is one from a notification, say
Use the order below. A choice made on a post lasts until restart. Links to comments keep Facebook's order.
column2: Aşağıdaki sırayı kullanır. Gönderide seçilen sıra yeniden başlatmaya kadar geçerlidir. Yorum bağlantıları Facebook sırasını korur.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Meta AI writes a short summary of what a post's comments say
Hide Meta AI comment summaries
# context: summary of that switch; the buttons are a post's Like, Comment and Share row
Hides Meta AI's summary at the top of comments and the comment summary under a post's buttons. The comments themselves stay.
column2: Yorumların üstündeki Meta AI özetini ve bir gönderinin düğmelerinin altındaki yorum özetini gizler. Yorumların kendisi kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; the few comments Facebook shows under a post in the feed, below its Like, Comment and Share row
Hide comments under posts
# context: summary of that switch; Comment is the post's Comment button
Feed posts stop showing a few comments under their buttons. Tap Comment to read them all.
column2: Akıştaki gönderiler düğmelerinin altında yorum göstermez. Hepsini okumak için Yorum Yap'a dokunun.

column1: Hide dislike on comments
Takes the thumbs-down off comments. Like and Reply stay.
column2: Yorumlardaki aşağı başparmağı kaldırır. Beğen ve Yanıtla kalır.

column1: Hide Like on comments
Takes Like off the row under comments. Reply and the reaction count stay.
column2: Yorumların altındaki satırdan Beğen'i kaldırır. Yanıtla ve tepki sayısı kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Like is the button under a post or a comment
Like only
# context: summary of that switch; the reactions are the row of Love, Haha, Wow and the rest that a long press on Like opens
A long press on Like doesn't open the reactions. A tap still likes.
column2: Beğen'e uzun basmak artık tepkileri açmaz. Bir dokunuş yine beğenir.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; GIF and sticker are two buttons in the box where you type a comment
Hide GIF and sticker buttons
# context: summary of that switch; the comment box is where you type a comment
The comment box loses its GIF and sticker buttons. Typing, photos and posting work as before.
column2: Yorum kutusu GIF ve çıkartma düğmelerini kaybeder. Yazmak, fotoğraf eklemek ve paylaşmak eskisi gibi çalışır.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments: hides the Add a comment field at the bottom of the full-screen video viewer
Hide the video comment box
The Add a comment box under a full-screen video goes away. Comment boxes on posts stay.
column2: Tam ekran bir videonun altındaki yorum alanı kaybolur. Gönderilerdeki yorum alanları kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; a reply thread is the replies under a comment, which Facebook folds behind View replies
Open every reply thread
# context: summary of that switch; View replies is the link Facebook shows under a comment that has replies
Comments show their replies right away, so there's no View replies to tap.
column2: Yorumlar yanıtlarını hemen gösterir, Yanıtları gör'e dokunman gerekmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; it makes an open reply thread load the rest of its replies by itself as the list is scrolled
Load whole reply threads
# context: summary of that switch; View more replies is the row Facebook shows under an open thread that has more replies to load
An open reply thread keeps loading as you scroll, so there's no View more replies to tap.
column2: Açık bir yanıt dizisi sen kaydırdıkça yüklenmeye devam eder, daha fazla yanıt için dokunman gerekmez.

column1: Hide replies button
An open reply thread gets a Hide replies button, so you can close it again after reading.
column2: Açık bir yanıt dizisinde Yanıtları gizle düğmesi çıkar, böylece okuduktan sonra diziyi yeniden kapatabilirsin.

column1: Hide replies
# context: switch title under Comments; View more replies is the row under an open reply thread that loads more replies, and this makes the whole row take the tap instead of only its words
Tap anywhere on View more replies
column2: Daha fazla yanıt gör satırının her yerine dokun

column1: # context: summary of that switch
The whole View more replies row opens the replies, not just its words.
column2: Daha fazla yanıt gör satırının tamamı yanıtları açar, yalnızca yazısı değil.

column1: Hide related groups
A group post's comments end without the Related groups list and its Join buttons.
column2: Bir grup gönderisinin yorumları, İlgili gruplar listesi ve Katıl düğmeleri olmadan biter.

column1: # context: row title under Comments that opens Facebook's own settings; reaction counts are the numbers next to the reactions on a post
Hide reaction counts
# context: summary of that row; Preferences and Reaction preferences are the names Facebook's own settings use
Facebook has its own setting for this. Open Facebook's settings, then Preferences and Reaction preferences.
column2: Facebook'un bunun için kendi ayarı var. Facebook ayarlarını aç, ardından Tercihler ve Tepki tercihleri'ne git.

column1: # context: message shown when Facebook's own settings could not be opened from that row
Facebook's settings didn't open. You'll find Reaction preferences in its Settings, under Preferences.
column2: Facebook ayarları açılmadı. Tepki tercihleri, Facebook Ayarları'nda Tercihler altında.

column1: # context: title of the list of comment orders, and of its dialog
Comment order
# context: entry of that list: the order Facebook's servers pick, which is what happens without Hushfacebook
Facebook's choice
# context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Most relevant
# context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Newest
# context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
All comments
# context: summary of the list when Facebook's choice is picked; Most relevant is Facebook's own name for that order
Comments open in the order Facebook picks, which is usually Most relevant.
column2: Yorumlar Facebook'un seçtiği sırayla açılır. Bu genellikle En alakalı sıralamasıdır.

column1: # context: summary of the list; %1$s is one of the order names above, as Facebook's sort menu shows it
A post's comments open with %1$s picked in their sort menu, where the post offers it.
column2: Bir gönderinin yorumları, gönderi bunu sunuyorsa sıralama menüsünde %1$s seçili olarak açılır.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order to Facebook's choice
Comments will open in the order Facebook picks.
# context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order; %1$s is one of the order names above
Comments will open with %1$s picked in their sort menu.
column2: Yorumlar, sıralama menüsünde %1$s seçili olarak açılacak.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; the ads Facebook puts between search results
Hide sponsored search results
# context: summary of that switch
Hides ads between your search results. The results you searched for stay.
column2: Arama sonuçlarınız arasındaki reklamları gizler. Aradığınız sonuçlar kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the ads between the posts on a person's profile or a Page
Hide sponsored profile posts
# context: summary of that switch; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Hides ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page. Their own posts stay.
column2: Birinin profilindeki veya bir Sayfadaki gönderilerin arasındaki reklamları gizler. Kendi gönderileri kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a note is the short text bubble (or a 'Drop a thought' prompt) Facebook shows over a person's profile picture
Hide profile notes
# context: summary of that switch
Hides the note bubble that sits on profile pictures. Applies the next time you open a profile.
column2: Profil fotoğraflarının üzerindeki not balonunu gizler. Bir profili bir sonraki açışınızda uygulanır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Save is Facebook's own button that keeps a post in your saved items
Save button under posts
# context: summary of that switch; Like, Comment and Share are the buttons under a post
Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts. A saved post shows its bookmark filled in.
column2: Gönderilerin altında Beğen, Yorum Yap ve Paylaş'ın yanına Facebook'un kendi Kaydet düğmesini ekler. Kaydedilen bir gönderide yer imi dolu görünür.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; a button that saves a post's video or photos to the phone
Download button under posts
# context: summary of that switch; Downloads is the name of Hushfacebook's settings page for saving media
Adds a Download button under posts with a video or photos. It saves the video, the photo, or every photo of an album, using the Downloads settings.
column2: Video veya fotoğraf içeren gönderilerin altına bir İndir düğmesi ekler. Videoyu, fotoğrafı ya da bir albümün tüm fotoğraflarını İndirme ayarlarıyla kaydeder.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Like is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Like under posts
# context: switch title under News feed; Comment is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Comment under posts
# context: switch title under News feed; Share is Facebook's own button under a post
Hide Share under posts
# context: switch title under News feed; Send is Facebook's own button under a post that sends it in a chat
Hide Send under posts
# context: summary shared by those four switches
Takes this button out of the row under posts in the feed. The other buttons stay, and a post with all of its buttons hidden shows no row.
column2: Bu düğmeyi akıştaki gönderilerin altındaki satırdan kaldırır. Diğer düğmeler kalır ve tüm düğmeleri gizlenen bir gönderi satır göstermez.

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, followed by the patch name in brackets; the row in Facebook's own Menu that opens Hushfacebook settings
# context: a short message when the Hushfacebook row in Facebook's Menu couldn't open the settings
Hushfacebook settings can't open here. Long-press the Facebook logo instead.
column2: Hushfacebook ayarları burada açılamıyor. Bunun yerine Facebook logosuna basılı tut.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the row of groups Facebook suggests joining, shown between posts
Hide suggested groups
# context: summary of that switch; Discover more groups is the label of Facebook's own button under that row
Hides the row of groups to join between posts. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: Gönderilerin arasındaki katılabileceğiniz gruplar satırını gizler. Üyesi olduğunuz grupların gönderileri kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"
Hide Memories in the feed
Hide friend requests in the feed
Hide friends' locations
# context: switch title under News feed, part of Hide suggested and promoted posts; a post opened by tapping a notification
Hide more posts under notification posts
column2: Bildirim gönderilerinin altındaki diğer gönderileri gizle

column1: Hides Memories between posts, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries. Your Memories page stays.
column2: Gönderilerin arasındaki “Bu gün” gibi anıları ve arkadaşlık yıl dönümlerini gizler. Anılar sayfanız kalır.

column1: Hides friend requests shown between posts. Your requests stay under Friends.
column2: Gönderilerin arasında görünen arkadaşlık isteklerini gizler. İstekleriniz Arkadaşlar bölümünde kalır.

column1: Hides the card between posts that shows where your friends are.
column2: Gönderilerin arasında arkadaşlarınızın nerede olduğunu gösteren kartı gizler.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; "More from your friends" is the heading Facebook shows over that list
A post you open from a notification ends without the "More from your friends" list Facebook adds under it, which can carry ads.
column2: Bir bildirimden açtığınız gönderi, Facebook'un altına eklediği ve reklam içerebilen "Arkadaşlarınızdan daha fazlası" listesi olmadan biter.

column1: Hide the Find friends card
Hides the "Want to see more posts from friends?" card with its Find friends button where your friends' posts run out.
column2: Arkadaşlarınızın gönderileri bittiğinde çıkan, Arkadaşları bul düğmeli "Arkadaşlarınızdan daha fazla gönderi görmek ister misiniz?" kartını gizler.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Stories tray is the row of Stories at the top of the feed
Hides the row of Stories from people you aren't connected to, between posts. Your friends' Stories and the Stories tray stay.
column2: Gönderilerin arasında, bağlantınız olmayan kişilerin Hikayeler satırını gizler. Arkadaşlarınızın hikayeleri ve Hikayeler çubuğu kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; trending videos Facebook sends as push notifications
Block trending video notifications
# context: summary of that switch; reels are Facebook's short videos
Trending videos and the reels Facebook picked for you stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Trend videolar ve Facebook'un senin için seçtiği reels videoları artık bildirimlerinde görünmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; memories are Facebook's posts from past years on the same day
Block memory notifications
# context: summary of that switch; On this day is the name Facebook gives its memories feature
Facebook's "On this day" memories stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Facebook'un “Geçmişte Bugün” anıları artık bildirimlerinde görünmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reminders of friends' birthdays
Block birthday notifications
# context: summary of that switch
No more reminders that it's a friend's birthday.
column2: Bir arkadaşının doğum günü olduğunu hatırlatan bildirimler artık gelmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Block group and Page highlights
column2: Grup ve Sayfa öne çıkanlarını engelle

column1: # context: summary of that switch; creators are the people and Pages who post videos and posts you follow
Digests of what's going on in groups, Pages and creators you follow stop. Comments, replies and mentions still come through.
column2: Takip ettiğin gruplarda, Sayfalarda ve içerik üreticilerinde olup bitenlerin özetleri gelmez. Yorumlar, yanıtlar ve bahsetmeler gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; People you may know is Facebook's name for its friend suggestions, as in Hide "People you may know"
Block "People you may know"
# context: summary of that switch; friend requests are other notifications, which always come through
Friend suggestions stop showing up in your notifications. Friend requests still come through.
column2: Arkadaş önerileri artık bildirimlerinde görünmez. Arkadaşlık istekleri gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; places near you and weather alerts Facebook sends
Block nearby and weather notifications
column2: Yakındaki yerler ve hava durumu bildirimlerini engelle

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Alerts about places near you and about the weather stop.
column2: Yakınındaki yerler ve hava durumuyla ilgili uyarılar gelmez.

column1: Block account setup reminders
Reminders to finish setting up a Facebook account stop. Login and security alerts still come through.
column2: Bir Facebook hesabının kurulumunu tamamlama hatırlatıcıları gelmez. Giriş ve güvenlik uyarıları gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; group activity is the notifications about new posts and activity in groups you're in
Block group activity notifications
# context: summary of the group activity switch
Notifications about new activity in your groups stop. Comments, replies and mentions in groups still come through.
column2: Gruplarındaki yeni etkinliklerle ilgili bildirimler gelmez. Gruplardaki yorumlar, yanıtlar ve bahsetmeler gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; an event invite is someone inviting you to a Facebook event
Block event invites
# context: summary of the event invites switch
Invites to events stop showing up in your notifications.
# context: switch title under Notifications; a live video is a broadcast someone is streaming right now
Block live video notifications
# context: summary of the live video switch; the ones you asked Facebook for are live notifications you turned on for a person or Page
Notifications that someone is live stop, including the ones you asked Facebook for.
column2: Birinin canlı yayında olduğuna dair bildirimler gelmez, Facebook'tan istediklerin de dahil.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reactions are likes and the other reaction buttons on posts and comments
Block reaction notifications
# context: summary of the reactions switch
Likes and reactions to your posts and comments stop showing up in your notifications. Comments still come through.
column2: Gönderilerine ve yorumlarına gelen beğeniler ve tepkiler artık bildirimlerinde görünmez. Yorumlar gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; quiet hours is a stretch of the day when the picked notification kinds are blocked
Quiet hours
# context: summary of the quiet hours switch; the switches above are the notification switches, the two times below are the start and end rows
The switches above block their kinds only between the two times below. The rest of the day those kinds come through.
column2: Yukarıdaki anahtarlar türlerini yalnızca aşağıdaki iki saat arasında engeller. Günün geri kalanında bu türler gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours begin
Quiet hours start
# context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours finish
Quiet hours end
# context: title of a note under Notifications, below the switches; what no switch there blocks
What always comes through
# context: text of that note; Android's own settings are the phone's per-app notification categories, which Facebook's server defines
Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls, login alerts and any kind not listed above always arrive. Android's notification settings for Facebook can block more.
column2: Mesajlar, arkadaşlık istekleri, yorumlar, bahsetmeler, aramalar, giriş uyarıları ve yukarıda listelenmeyen her tür her zaman gelir. Android'in Facebook için bildirim ayarları daha fazlasını engelleyebilir.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; the stories Facebook suggests in the Stories tray from accounts you don't follow
Hide suggested stories
# context: summary of that switch; Suggested is the label Facebook shows under such a story in the tray, and the tray reloads on its own schedule
Shows only friends and followed Pages in the Stories tray. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.

With %1$s on, Home will show the same posts as %2$s in the Feeds tab.
column2: %1$s açıkken Ana Sayfa, Akışlar sekmesindeki %2$s ile aynı gönderileri gösterecek.

column1: # context: The optional matching mode for both post word lists.
Match whole words
Matches whole words only, in both lists. For example, "hat" matches "hat!" but not "what" or "hats".
column2: Her iki listede de yalnızca tam sözcükleri eşleştirir. Örneğin "hat", "hat!" ile eşleşir ama "what" veya "hats" ile eşleşmez.

On

column2: Şu an kayıtlı %1$s. İçe aktarma sonrası %2$s.

Version %1$s

Build %1$s (source unknown)
Tap Resume, then restart Facebook.
column2: Devam et'e dokunun, ardından Facebook'u yeniden başlatın.

column1: Turn off haptics
Stops the small vibrations Facebook makes when you tap or swipe. Your keyboard and phone vibrations aren't affected.
column2: Facebook'un dokunma veya kaydırma sırasında yaptığı küçük titreşimleri durdurur. Klavyenizin ve telefonunuzun titreşimleri etkilenmez.

column1: Turn off screen transitions
Tabs, the Menu, photos and screens that open over Facebook appear at once instead of sliding or zooming in. Swiping between tabs still works.
column2: Sekmeler, Menü, fotoğraflar ve Facebook'un üzerinde açılan ekranlar kayarak ya da yakınlaşarak gelmek yerine hemen görünür. Sekmeler arasında kaydırma yine çalışır.

column1: Unlock app icons

Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus, on Facebook's App icon page. The Pick an app icon row opens that page. Your pick stays if you turn this off, so pick the blue one first to go back.
column2: Facebook'un Facebook Plus'a ayırdığı uygulama simgelerini, Facebook'un Uygulama simgesi sayfasında seçmenizi sağlar. Uygulama simgesi seç satırı bu sayfayı açar. Bunu kapatsanız da seçiminiz kalır, geri dönmek için önce mavi olanı seçin.

column1: # context: settings row under Appearance, right below the Unlock app icons switch; opens Facebook's own App icon page, so use Facebook's name for that page in this language
Pick an app icon
Opens Facebook's App icon page, even on accounts where Facebook doesn't list it in Settings and privacy.
column2: Facebook'un Uygulama simgesi sayfasını, Facebook'un Ayarlar ve gizlilik'te göstermediği hesaplarda da açar.

column1: Use the icon at the top of Home
Shows the app icon you picked at the top of Home instead of the Facebook wordmark. Needs Unlock app icons and a pick other than the blue one. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Seçtiğin uygulama simgesini Facebook yazısı yerine ana sayfanın üstünde gösterir. Uygulama simgelerinin kilidini aç ayarı ve maviden farklı bir seçim gerekir. Değişikliği görmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlat.

column1: # context: toast when the row above finds no App icon page in this Facebook build
This Facebook build has no App icon page.
column2: Bu Facebook sürümünde Uygulama simgesi sayfası yok.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; Android's own name for the floating video window
Picture-in-picture
# context: summary of that switch
A playing reel or full-screen video keeps going in a small window when you leave Facebook. Android 12 or later.
column2: Oynatılan bir reel ya da tam ekran video, Facebook'tan çıktığında küçük bir pencerede devam eder. Android 12 veya üstü.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; HDR is the high-contrast video and photo format some screens show brighter than everything else
Turn off HDR brightness
# context: summary of that switch
HDR videos and photos stay at your screen's usual brightness instead of turning it up to full. They keep their resolution.
column2: HDR videolar ve fotoğraflar, ekranı tam parlaklığa çıkarmak yerine ekranın her zamanki parlaklığında kalır. Çözünürlükleri değişmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, below Turn off HDR brightness; when a video comes in both HDR and SDR, the SDR copy plays. Keep HDR and SDR as they are
Play SDR versions of HDR videos
# context: summary of that switch; "the same size" means the same resolution; "the switch above" is Turn off HDR brightness
When Facebook also sends an HDR video in SDR at the same size, play that version instead. The screen doesn't brighten and the picture stays as sharp. Works with the switch above on or off.
column2: Facebook bir HDR videoyu aynı boyutta SDR olarak da gönderdiğinde onun yerine o sürüm oynatılır. Ekran parlamaz ve görüntü aynı netlikte kalır. Yukarıdaki anahtar açıkken de kapalıyken de çalışır.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; it makes videos play past the silent stretches of their sound
Skip silent parts
# context: summary of that switch; how-tos are tutorial videos
Videos, reels and stories jump past the quiet stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner.
column2: Videolar, Reels ve hikayeler sesteki sessiz bölümleri atlar, böylece konuşmalar ve nasıl yapılır videoları sadede daha çabuk gelir.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; feed videos stay silent until the user turns their sound on
Keep feed videos muted
# context: summary of that switch; the speaker is the sound button on a video, volume up is the phone's key
Videos in your feed start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only you turn it on. Tap a video's speaker or press volume up to hear it.
column2: Akışındaki videolar Facebook'u her açtığında sessiz başlar ve sesi yalnızca sen açarsın. Duymak için videonun hoparlör simgesine dokun veya ses açma tuşuna bas.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; keeps a video's progress bar (the line showing how far it has played) on screen
Keep the progress bar
# context: summary of that switch; a reel is a short vertical video
A reel's progress bar stays full size, ready to drag. A full-screen video's controls stay until you tap.
column2: Bir reel'in ilerleme çubuğu tam boyutta kalır ve sürüklemeye hazırdır. Tam ekran bir videonun kontrolleri siz dokunana kadar kalır.

column1: Show a reel's time
With Keep the progress bar on, a reel's elapsed and total time stay above the bar. Off, they show only while you drag it.
column2: İlerleme çubuğunu koru açıkken bir reel'in geçen ve toplam süresi çubuğun üstünde kalır. Kapalıyken yalnızca çubuğu sürüklerken görünür.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; while you press a reel's progress bar, the poster's name and the like, comment and share buttons stay on screen
Keep the name and buttons while seeking
# context: summary of that switch; the caption is the text under a reel
Pressing a reel's progress bar leaves the name, caption and buttons on screen. Off, Facebook clears them until you let go.
column2: Bir reel'in ilerleme çubuğuna bastığınızda ad, açıklama ve düğmeler ekranda kalır. Kapalıyken Facebook bunları siz bırakana kadar gizler.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback, after Show a reel's time; a tap on the video's progress bar jumps to that point
Tap the bar to seek
# context: description of that switch; the dot is the bar's round handle you drag
Tap anywhere on a reel's or video's progress bar to jump there, instead of dragging the dot.
column2: Bir reel'in ya da videonun ilerleme çubuğunda herhangi bir yere dokunarak oraya atlayın, noktayı sürüklemeden.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; View profile is Facebook's own button on a seller's Marketplace page that opens their regular Facebook profile, so use Facebook's label for it in this language
Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
# context: summary of that switch
Adds a View profile button to every seller's Marketplace page, opening their Facebook profile. Facebook only shows it to some accounts.
column2: Her Marketplace satıcı sayfasına, Facebook profilini açan bir Profili gör düğmesi ekler. Facebook bunu yalnızca bazı hesaplara gösterir.

column1: # context: the Save Facebook's notification sound row under Notifications and its toasts (#83)
Save Facebook's notification sound
Adds Facebook's chime to your phone's notification sounds, for categories set to None. Then pick it in Android's notification settings for Facebook, under Sound.
column2: Facebook'un bildirim sesini telefonunuzun bildirim seslerine ekler; sesi Hiçbiri olan kategoriler için. Sonra Android'in Facebook bildirim ayarlarında Ses bölümünden seçin.

column1: Saved as %1$s in the Notifications folder. Pick it under Sound in Android's notification settings for Facebook.
column2: Notifications klasörüne %1$s olarak kaydedildi. Android'in Facebook bildirim ayarlarında Ses altından seç.

column1: %1$s is already in your notification sounds.
This build has no notification sound to save.
column2: Bu derlemede kaydedilecek bir bildirim sesi yok.

column1: Couldn't save the sound. Try again.
# context: switch title on the Feed page; the composer row is the "What's on your mind?" box at the top of Home where a post starts
Hide the composer row
# context: summary of that switch; use the wording Facebook itself uses in this language for "What's on your mind?" and Home
Hides the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home. The create button in the top bar still starts a post.
column2: Ana Sayfa'nın üstündeki “Aklında ne var?” satırını gizler. Üst çubuktaki oluştur düğmesi yine gönderi başlatır.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; Clean mode is Facebook's own three-dot menu item on a reel or video that hides the buttons down the side, so use Facebook's name for it in this language (#75)
Always use Clean mode
# context: summary of that switch; "the usual way" means Facebook's own way out of Clean mode
Opens reels and videos in Facebook's Clean mode, which hides the buttons down the side. You can still leave Clean mode as usual. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reelleri ve videoları Facebook'un Temiz modunda açar; bu mod yandaki düğmeleri gizler. Temiz moddan yine her zamanki gibi çıkabilirsiniz. Varsayılan olarak kapalı, çünkü gerçek bir hesapta henüz denenmedi.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; each reel plays to its end one time and stops there instead of starting over
Play reels once
# context: summary of that switch; "last frame" is the final picture of the video, which stays on screen

A reel stops on its last frame instead of starting over. Tap it to watch again, or swipe to the next one. Feed videos and stories aren't changed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Bir reel baştan başlamak yerine son karesinde durur. Yeniden izlemek için dokunun ya da sonrakine kaydırın. Akıştaki videolar ve hikayeler değişmez. Varsayılan olarak kapalı, çünkü gerçek bir hesapta henüz denenmedi.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, part of Clean up Reels; reels and videos play in the language they were recorded in instead of an audio track Facebook translated
Keep the original audio
# context: summary of that switch; "dubbed" means the spoken audio was replaced by a translated voice; Meta AI is the company's AI assistant, keep the name
Reels and videos play with the sound they were made with, not a version Facebook dubbed into your language with Meta AI. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Reeller ve videolar, Facebook'un Meta AI ile dilinize seslendirdiği bir sürümle değil, yapıldıkları sesle oynatılır. Varsayılan olarak kapalı, çünkü gerçek bir hesapta henüz denenmedi.

column1: # context: settings section title on the App page, above the switches of Hide Meta upsells; Meta is the company
Meta's other products
# context: switch title; Edits is Meta's video editing app, keep its name
Hide Edits promotions
# context: switch title; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; cross-posting means sharing a Facebook post to Threads as well
Hide Threads cross-posting prompts

# context: switch title under Meta's other products; Threads is Meta's app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Threads in the share sheet

# context: switch title under Meta's other products; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post, use Facebook's own word for it in this language
Hide Muse in the share sheet
# context: switch title; Meta Verified is Meta's paid subscription, keep its name
Hide Meta Verified offers
# context: switch title; avatar stickers are stickers made from your Facebook avatar
Hide avatar sticker promotions
# context: summary of the Edits switch; the pill is a small button under a video in the feed that opens Edits
Hides the Edits button in the Reels composer and the Edits pill under videos. You can still make reels in Facebook.
column2: Reels oluşturucudaki Edits düğmesini ve videoların altındaki Edits etiketini gizler. Facebook'ta yine reel yapabilirsiniz.

column1: # context: summary of the Threads switch; the composer is where you write a new post
Facebook stops asking whether to share your post to Threads too. Posting to Facebook works as before.
column2: Facebook, gönderinizi Threads'te de paylaşmak isteyip istemediğinizi sormayı bırakır. Facebook'ta paylaşım eskisi gibi çalışır.

column1: # context: summary of the Threads share sheet switch; the share sheet is the panel that opens when you tap Share on a post
Removes the Threads button when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: Bir şey paylaşırken Threads düğmesini kaldırır. Diğer paylaşım yolları aynı sırayla kalır.

column1: # context: summary of the Muse share sheet switch; Muse is Meta's AI agent app, keep its name
Removes Muse, Meta's AI agent app, when you share something. All other ways to share stay, in the same order.
column2: Bir şey paylaşırken Meta'nın yapay zekâ asistanı uygulaması Muse'u kaldırır. Diğer paylaşım yolları aynı sırayla kalır.

column1: # context: summary of the Meta Verified switch; the label is a line Facebook adds under the poster's name on some posts
No Meta Verified offer after you post, and no Meta Verified label under the names on posts. Posting works as usual.
column2: Paylaşım yaptıktan sonra Meta Verified teklifi çıkmaz, gönderilerdeki isimlerin altında Meta Verified etiketi de görünmez. Paylaşım her zamanki gibi çalışır.

column1: # context: summary of the avatar sticker switch; promotion slots are the cards Facebook uses to suggest its own features
Hides avatar sticker promotions in comments and elsewhere, and the prompt to make an avatar. Stickers still send.
column2: Yorumlarda ve diğer yerlerde avatar çıkartması tanıtımlarını ve avatar oluşturma önerisini gizler. Çıkartmalar yine gönderilir.

column1: # context: switch title under Meta's other products; Imagine is Meta AI's image maker, keep its name
Hide Meta AI's Imagine
# context: switch title under Meta's other products; Meta AI is Meta's assistant and keeps its name; the buttons sit under some posts
Hide other Meta AI buttons under posts
column2: Gönderilerin altındaki diğer Meta AI düğmelerini gizle

column1: # context: summary of the Imagine switch; Imagine me is a button Facebook puts under some posts, keep its name; Create story is Facebook's screen for making a story, use Facebook's own name for it in this language
Hides the Imagine me button on posts and the Imagine option when you write a post or create a story. Everything else works as before.
column2: Gönderilerdeki Imagine me düğmesini ve gönderi yazarken ya da hikaye oluştururken görünen Imagine seçeneğini gizler. Geri kalan her şey eskisi gibi çalışır.

column1: # context: summary of the switch that hides the other Meta AI buttons; these are buttons Facebook puts under some posts that open Meta AI; the next button is whatever other button the post would show there
Hides the other Meta AI buttons Facebook puts under posts. The post's next button shows instead, if it has one.
column2: Facebook'un gönderilerin altına koyduğu diğer Meta AI düğmelerini gizler. Varsa gönderinin sonraki düğmesi onun yerine görünür.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Stories that replays a finished story; it works together with the Stop Story auto-advance switch
Loop stories
# context: summary of the Loop stories switch; "Stop Story auto-advance" is the label of the switch above it, so use its translation
With Stop Story auto-advance on, a finished story plays again from the start instead of waiting on its last frame. Tap or swipe to move on.
column2: Hikayelerin otomatik ilerlemesini durdur açıkken, biten bir hikaye son karesinde beklemek yerine baştan yeniden oynar. Devam etmek için dokun veya kaydır.

column1: # context: label of a switch under Downloads that adds a Save photo item to the three-dot menu of posts with photos
Save photo in post menus
# context: summary of the Save photo in post menus switch; "Save any photo" is the label of the switch above it and "Save photo" is the menu item, so use their translations
With Save any photo on, a post with photos gets Save photo in its three-dot menu too. A post with several saves each one, one after another.
column2: Her fotoğrafı kaydet açıkken, fotoğraflı bir gönderinin üç nokta menüsünde de Fotoğrafı kaydet çıkar. Birden çok fotoğraf varsa her biri sırayla kaydedilir.

column1: # context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves the post's one photo to the phone
Save photo
# context: primary save row for a Story that reshares a Reel
Save video
# context: menu item in a post's three-dot menu that saves every photo of a post with several photos
Save all photos
# context: short message shown when the photos of a post could not start saving
Couldn't save this post's photos. Try again in a moment.
column2: Bu gönderinin fotoğrafları kaydedilemedi. Birazdan tekrar dene.

column1: # context: row in a comment's long-press sheet that saves the GIF the comment holds; keep it short like Save photo
Save GIF
# context: message after a tap on Save GIF when the save didn't start
Couldn't save this GIF. Try again in a moment.
column2: Bu GIF kaydedilemedi. Birazdan tekrar dene.

column1: # context: sentence added after the summary of the Save any photo switch; Save GIF is the row's name, keep it as translated for that row
A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it.
column2: Bir GIF yorumuna basılı tuttuğunda GIF'i kaydet çıkar.

column1: Couldn't save this story's photo. Try again in a moment.
column2: Bu hikayenin fotoğrafı kaydedilemedi. Birazdan tekrar dene.

column1: Too many saves at once. Try again when one finishes.
column2: Aynı anda çok fazla indirme var. Biri bitince tekrar dene.

column1: # context: settings switch under Block Instant Games ads that makes a game's rewarded ad count as watched
Answer rewarded game ads as watched
# context: description under that switch
With Block Instant Games ads on, a game's rewarded ad counts as watched. No ad plays and the game still gives its reward.
column2: “Instant Games reklamlarını engelle” açıkken oyunun ödüllü reklamı izlenmiş sayılır. Reklam oynatılmaz ve oyun ödülünü yine de verir.

column1: # context: title of the list that picks the quality reels start at
Reels quality
# context: title of the list that picks the quality video stories start at
Stories quality
# context: first choice in the Reels and Stories quality lists: follow the Default quality row
Same as default
# context: summary of the Reels quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Reels follow the Default quality row.
# context: summary of the Stories quality list when it follows the Playback quality row
Video stories follow the Default quality row.
column2: Video hikayeler, Varsayılan kalite satırını izler.

column1: # context: summary of the Reels quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for reels, whatever Default quality is set to.
column2: Varsayılan kalite ne olursa olsun reels için %1$s.

column1: # context: summary of the Stories quality list when it has a quality of its own; %1$s is that choice, such as Highest or Up to 720p
%1$s for video stories, whatever Default quality is set to.
column2: Varsayılan kalite ne olursa olsun video hikayeler için %1$s.

column1: # context: title of the row naming a folder inside the save folder that video saves go in
Video subfolder
# context: title of the row naming a folder inside the save folder that photo saves go in
Photo subfolder
# context: dialog text of the Video subfolder row
Choose a folder for videos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep videos in the save folder itself.
column2: Kayıt klasörünün içinde videolar için bir klasör seç. Geçersiz karakterler alt çizgiye dönüşür. Videoların doğrudan kayıt klasöründe kalması için boş bırak.

column1: # context: dialog text of the Photo subfolder row
Choose a folder for photos inside the save folder. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to keep photos in the save folder itself.
column2: Kayıt klasörünün içinde fotoğraflar için bir klasör seç. Geçersiz karakterler alt çizgiye dönüşür. Fotoğrafların doğrudan kayıt klasöründe kalması için boş bırak.

column1: # context: summary of the Video subfolder row; %1$s is a folder path such as Movies/Facebook/Clips
Videos go to %1$s.
# context: summary of the Photo subfolder row; %1$s is a folder path such as Pictures/Facebook/Photos
Photos go to %1$s.

Hide the Home tab badge
# context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Friends tab
Hide the Friends tab badge
# context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Marketplace tab
Hide the Marketplace tab badge
# context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Notifications tab
Hide the Notifications tab badge
# context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Menu tab
Hide the Menu tab badge
# context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off the Groups tab
Hide the Groups tab badge
# context: switch that takes the new-item dot and count off every tab without a switch of its own
Hide other tabs' badges
# context: switch that keeps Facebook from putting its count on the launcher icon
Hide the app icon count
# context: summary of the switch for the badges on every tab without a switch of its own
No dot or count on Feeds, Gaming, Events and the other tabs not listed here. The Reels tab has its own switch.
column2: Akışlar, Oyun, Etkinlikler ve burada listelenmeyen diğer sekmelerde nokta ya da sayı olmaz. Reels sekmesinin kendi anahtarı var.

column1: # context: summary of each tab's badge switch
No dot or count on this tab. Its page still shows what's new when you open it.
column2: Bu sekmede nokta ya da sayı olmaz. Sayfası açtığında yenilikleri göstermeye devam eder.

column1: # context: summary of the app icon count switch
No number on Facebook's app icon. Notifications still arrive. Some launchers add their own count, which this can't remove.
column2: Facebook uygulama simgesinde sayı görünmez. Bildirimler yine gelir. Bazı başlatıcılar kendi sayacını ekler, bunu buradan kaldıramayız.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; it shows posts and reel captions in their original language instead of Facebook's automatic translation
Turn off auto-translation
# context: description of that switch; See translation is the name of Facebook's own link under a post that translates it on request
Posts and reel captions stay in the language they were written in. Facebook's See translation link stays under them.
column2: Gönderiler ve reels açıklamaları yazıldıkları dilde kalır. Facebook'un Çevirisini gör bağlantısı altlarında durur.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch, below Keep the reel speed; it keeps a playback speed picked on a feed or Watch video for the next videos
Keep the video speed
# context: description of that switch; the gear menu is the settings button on a video's player, where Playback speed is picked
The speed you pick in a feed or Watch video's menu carries over to the next videos. Reels keep their own speed. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real account yet.
column2: Akıştaki veya Watch'taki bir videonun menüsünden seçtiğiniz hız sonraki videolara da geçer. Reeller kendi hızını korur. Varsayılan olarak kapalı, çünkü gerçek bir hesapta henüz denenmedi.

column1: # context: switch title under Downloads, below Download feed and Watch videos; it offers to download a reel or video whose link the user copied
Offer to download copied links
# context: description of that switch; Download feed and Watch videos is the name of the switch above it
With Download feed and Watch videos on, coming back to Facebook with a reel or video link copied offers to download it, once per link. Off, Facebook doesn't look at what you copied.
column2: Akış ve Watch videolarını indir açıkken, kopyalanmış bir reel veya video bağlantısıyla Facebook'a döndüğünde onu indirmen önerilir, her bağlantı için bir kez. Kapalıyken Facebook kopyaladığın şeye bakmaz.

column1: # context: title of the dialog that offers to download the video whose link is on the clipboard; the link shows under it
Download the video you copied?
# context: button of that dialog that declines; the same link is never offered again
No thanks
# context: toast when a copied share link couldn't be followed to a video, so Facebook opened the link itself
Couldn't find the video in that link, so it opened in Facebook instead.
column2: Bu bağlantıda video bulunamadı, bu yüzden Facebook'ta açıldı.

column1: # context: toast when Download on a copied link opens the video first, so Facebook loads it and the save can start
Opening the video to save it
# context: switch title under Stories, View stories anonymously's second switch; it adds an eye button over each story
Mark as seen button
# context: description of the Mark as seen button switch
Adds an eye button to the top of each story while you view anonymously. Tap it to show up on that story's viewer list. The other stories stay hidden.
column2: Anonim izlerken her hikayenin üstüne bir göz düğmesi ekler. O hikayenin izleyici listesinde görünmek için düğmeye dokun. Diğer hikayeler gizli kalır.

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button over a story while that story is still hidden from its viewer list
Mark as seen
# context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the story is marked and waiting to be sent; a second tap takes the mark back
Marked as seen. Tap again to undo.
column2: Görüldü olarak işaretlendi. Geri almak için tekrar dokun.

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the marked story was sent as seen
Marked as seen and sent
# context: the word lists' dialogs, after their first paragraph: a line between slashes is a regular expression; %1$d is how many a list holds, %2$d the most characters each
A line between slashes, like /gr[ae]y/, is a pattern that can match several spellings (a regular expression). A list holds up to %1$d, each up to %2$d characters.
column2: Eğik çizgiler arasındaki bir satır, örneğin /gr[ae]y/, birkaç yazımla eşleşebilen bir kalıptır (düzenli ifade). Bir liste en fazla %1$d tane tutar, her biri en fazla %2$d karakter.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: a line written between slashes isn't a pattern the app can read; %1$d is the line's number
Line %1$d isn't a pattern Hushfacebook can read. Fix it or remove it, then save again.
column2: %1$d. satır Hushfacebook'un okuyabildiği bir kalıp değil. Düzelt ya da sil, sonra yeniden kaydet.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: more patterns than a list holds; %1$d is the most a list holds
A list holds up to %1$d patterns, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: Bir liste en fazla %1$d kalıp alır ve bu listede daha fazlası var. Birkaçını silip yeniden kaydet.

Hide photo posts

Hide video posts

Hide link posts

Hides posts with a photo or album, including shares.
column2: Fotoğraf veya albüm içeren gönderileri, paylaşımlar dahil, gizler.

Hides posts with a video, including shares. Reels in the feed have their own switch.
column2: Video içeren gönderileri, paylaşımlar dahil, gizler. Akıştaki reellerin kendi anahtarı var.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide link posts switch
Hides posts that share a link to a website, with its preview card.
column2: Bir web sitesine bağlantı paylaşan gönderileri, önizleme kartıyla birlikte gizler.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide posts on a colored background switch
Hides short posts shown as big text on a colored background.
column2: Renkli bir arka planda büyük yazı olarak görünen kısa gönderileri gizler.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed: hides posts that share someone else's post, the ones Facebook heads "shared a post"; use Facebook's own word for a shared post in this language
Hide reposts
# context: summary of the Hide reposts switch; a caption is what the sharer wrote above the shared post
Hides posts that share another post, with or without a caption. Original posts stay. Off by default, since it hasn't been tried on a real feed yet.
column2: Başka bir gönderiyi paylaşan gönderileri, açıklamalı ya da açıklamasız, gizler. Özgün gönderiler kalır. Varsayılan olarak kapalı, çünkü gerçek bir akışta henüz denenmedi.

column1: Hide posts from Pages
Hides posts written by Pages, the ones you follow too. Posts from friends and groups stay, and so does a friend's share of a Page's post.
column2: Sayfaların yazdığı gönderileri gizler, takip ettiğin sayfalar da dahil. Arkadaşlarının ve grupların gönderileri kalır, bir arkadaşının paylaştığı sayfa gönderisi de kalır.

column1: # context: switch title in Privacy: asks for the phone's own screen lock before Facebook shows
Lock Facebook
Save crashes to Downloads
When Facebook crashes, the error goes in a text file in Download/Hushfacebook, so you can send it with a bug report even if Facebook won't open. Links and IDs are left out. The newest five are kept.
column2: Facebook çöktüğünde hata, Download/Hushfacebook klasörüne bir metin dosyası olarak kaydedilir, böylece Facebook açılmasa bile bir hata raporuyla gönderebilirsiniz. Bağlantılar ve kimlikler dahil edilmez. En yeni beş dosya saklanır.

column1: # context: switch title in Privacy: Facebook quits fully a few seconds after you switch away from it
Close Facebook when you leave it

A few seconds after you leave Facebook, it closes all the way and leaves your recent apps, so it isn't running in the background. It waits for uploads and saves to finish first. Notifications may come late, or not until you open Facebook again.
column2: Facebook'tan çıktıktan birkaç saniye sonra tamamen kapanır ve son uygulamalardan kalkar, böylece arka planda çalışmaz. Önce yüklemelerin ve kaydetmelerin bitmesini bekler. Bildirimler geç gelebilir ya da Facebook'u yeniden açana kadar gelmeyebilir.

column1: # context: summary of the Lock Facebook switch; the time below is the Lock after row under it
Facebook asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock at startup and when you return after the time below. Your phone needs a screen lock.
column2: Facebook, açılırken ve aşağıdaki süreden sonra geri döndüğünüzde parmak izi, yüz veya ekran kilidi ister. Telefonunuzda ekran kilidi olmalı.

column1: # context: toast when Lock Facebook is turned on and the phone has no screen lock to ask for
Set a screen lock in your phone's settings first, so Facebook has something to ask for.
column2: Facebook'un isteyebileceği bir şey olsun diye önce telefonunun ayarlarından bir ekran kilidi ayarla.

Facebook's text will be the size your phone's font size setting gives it.
column2: Facebook'taki metin, telefonunun yazı tipi boyutu ayarının verdiği boyutta olacak.

Facebook will keep its own blue.

If your patched Facebook includes Accent color, Facebook's blue will be %1$s.

Send photos and videos at original quality

Sends photos and videos in Facebook chats at full quality. Photos lose location and camera details. Big files and videos with a location tag are still shrunk.
column2: Facebook sohbetlerinde fotoğrafları ve videoları tam kalitede gönderir. Fotoğraflar konum ve kamera bilgisini kaybeder. Büyük dosyalar ve konum etiketli videolar yine küçültülür.

Hide posts you've already seen

Posts you've scrolled past stay out of the feed when it loads again. The list stays on this phone. Turning this off empties it.

Empties the list of posts you've seen, so they can show up again.

Seen posts forgotten.
# context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a time such as 7 days
Posts you've seen will stay hidden for %1$s.
# context: settings row under Pause, backup and diagnostics that opens Facebook's own Whitehat screen; Whitehat is Facebook's name for its security researcher program, keep it
Facebook's Whitehat settings
# context: summary of that row when Facebook's screen is on the phone

Facebook's own screen for security testing. It can make Facebook trust security certificates you installed, or send its data through a proxy (a go-between server). Hushfacebook doesn't change anything there.
column2: Facebook'un güvenlik testleri için kendi ekranı. Facebook'un yüklediğiniz güvenlik sertifikalarına güvenmesini veya verilerini bir proxy (aracı sunucu) üzerinden göndermesini sağlayabilir. Hushfacebook orada hiçbir şeyi değiştirmez.

column1: # context: summary of that row when Facebook hasn't downloaded the screen, so the row opens a web page
Facebook hasn't downloaded this screen to this phone, so a tap opens the Whitehat page on the web instead.
column2: Facebook bu ekranı bu telefona indirmedi, bu yüzden dokunduğunda web'deki Whitehat sayfası açılır.

column1: Only the first reel waits

column2: Yukarıdaki anahtar açıkken bir reel oynattıktan sonra kaydırdığınız reeller kendiliğinden oynar. Akış, Watch ve hikayeler her zaman bekler.

column1: Slower speeds
Adds 0.1x and 0.25x to the speed menu of reels and of feed and Watch videos, for slowing down a fast moment.
column2: Reellerin ve akış ile Watch videolarının hız menüsüne 0,1x ve 0,25x seçeneklerini ekler; hızlı geçen bir anı yavaşlatmak için.

column1: Speed on finished live videos
A live video that has ended gets Playback speed in its gear menu, like other videos. Videos that are still live, and ads, keep Facebook's menu.
column2: Sona ermiş bir canlı video, diğer videolar gibi dişli menüsünde Oynatma hızı seçeneğini alır. Hâlâ canlı olan videolar ve reklamlar Facebook'un menüsünü korur.

column2: Bu uygulamalar kendi reklamlarını gösterir ya da hiç göstermez, ödüllü reklamları da çalışmayabilir.

Usage statistics uploads
# context: added to that line's summary: what else holding the uploads stops, and when a change of its switch takes effect
Facebook's on-phone learning jobs stop too, and a change applies after Facebook restarts.
column2: Facebook'un telefondaki öğrenme görevleri de durur ve bir değişiklik Facebook yeniden başladıktan sonra geçerli olur.

column1: # context: a line of that list: the list of watched reels Facebook is sent
Reel watch history
# context: added to that line's summary: what not sending the history costs
Reels you've already seen may come back.
column2: Daha önce izlediğiniz reeller geri gelebilir.

Blocked since you patched. There's no switch for it.
column2: Yamaladığından beri engelli. Bunun için anahtar yok.

column1: # context: summary of a line in that list with a switch; %1$s is the switch's name, %2$s the settings page it's on
Its switch is %1$s, in %2$s.
# context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, next to Share sheet items to hide
Hide group buttons in the share sheet
# context: that switch's summary. Send to group and Send separately are the buttons Facebook's share sheet shows when two or more people are picked
Takes away Send to group when you pick two or more people, and the share sheet's own ways to start a new group, so nothing you share makes a group chat by accident. Send separately stays.
column2: İki veya daha fazla kişi seçtiğinde “Gruba gönder” seçeneğini ve paylaşırken yeni grup başlatma yollarını kaldırır, böylece paylaştığın hiçbir şey yanlışlıkla grup sohbeti oluşturmaz. “Ayrı ayrı gönder” kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, right after Remove tracking from shared links
Share the post's own link
# context: that switch's summary. Copy link is the share sheet item of that name; facebook.com/share/ is a web address and stays as written
Copy link and the share sheet's other link shares give the post's own facebook.com address instead of a facebook.com/share/ link made for that one share.
column2: “Bağlantıyı kopyala” ve paylaşım menüsündeki diğer bağlantı paylaşma yolları, yalnızca o paylaşım için oluşturulan bir facebook.com/share/ bağlantısı yerine gönderinin kendi facebook.com adresini verir.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments in Hushfacebook settings, after Hide related groups
Hide comments with shop links
# context: that switch's summary. Shopee, Lazada and Amazon are online shops and stay as written
Hides comments that link to a shop like Shopee, Lazada or Amazon, along with their replies.
column2: Shopee, Lazada veya Amazon gibi bir mağazaya bağlantı veren yorumları yanıtlarıyla birlikte gizler.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments, right after Hide comments with shop links
Hide comments with your words
# context: that switch's summary. Words to hide is the word list row under News feed and Words that keep a post its second list; use the same translations as those rows
Hides comments containing a word from your Words to hide list in News feed, along with their replies. Words that keep a post keep a comment too.
column2: Akış bölümündeki Gizlenecek kelimeler listenizden bir sözcük içeren yorumları yanıtlarıyla birlikte gizler. Gönderiyi tutan kelimeler yorumu da tutar.

Restart Facebook to apply this change
